checkpoint.summary: Active goals and 2026-09-10 lessons are capsule records surfaced first at re-entry.

do_not_assume: A companion discovery document is a second authority; the project .awp.md Capsule is the normative entry point
Structural re-entry completeness implies complete decision context
The current local tools implement task-scoped decision closure
The AWP 0.8 draft retains a separate Coordination C0-C3 ladder
The current local tools are a complete COOP-1 binding
COOP-1 provides COOP-2 semantic awareness or integration assurance, or COOP-3 authentication, fencing, or scale
Imported authority grants external side effects
A watcher declared at join is a live watcher; liveness is derived from heartbeats only
The entry slice is authoritative on its own; it is refused unless its capsule digest matches
handoff.requested_action: Implement and test task-scoped decision-closure projection in the reference re-entry tool, then migrate remaining accepted project decisions to explicit affects and source references where useful.

read_first.statement: Doorbells work after a reboot or restart with no manual AWP commands: every agent that starts in an AWP project joins the generic Git-event doorbell path.
Sharply reduce doom looping: agents losing the active goal or relearning lessons the project already learned.
Record durable lessons in the capsule before a checkpoint and cite goals by record id; agent-private memory is not a substitute.
Size COOP-2 delivery and response windows for the recipient's observation mode: hours or days for on-entry-only participants, never minutes.
decision_owner is a human principal (principal:mark), never a participant actor or actor:user.
A Cowork session cannot host a watcher (its device-shell processes end with each call); treat it as on-entry-only and never require it to acknowledge within a heartbeat TTL.
SQLite WAL across the Windows host / Cowork VM mount fails intermittently; retry a bounded number of times, then disclose AWP-COORD-LEDGER-UNAVAILABLE. It is not a new defect.
Across that mount, run read-only git as git --no-optional-locks and check for a stranded .git/index.lock after any index-writing command.
Define a portable workstate format for LLM session continuation and multi-agent code coordination.
Portable state must not require private chain-of-thought or hidden runtime state.

read_first.choice: Keep released artifacts and identifiers immutable; develop normative changes under spec/drafts; use minor versions for incompatible 0.x changes; publish errata or new versions rather than moving tags.
read_first.question: How should AWP distinguish released protocol semantics from development?

read_first.choice: Use no named contract for portable collaboration; COOP-1 for small-group conflict reduction, COOP-2 for semantic and integration coordination, and COOP-3 for protected scalable coordination. Consultation is an independently enabled optional subprotocol.
read_first.question: How should AWP express cooperation and coordination conformance?
read_first.supersession_rationale: The cumulative COOP ladder replaces the earlier split between Cooperation contracts and a separate Coordination conformance axis.

read_first.choice: The project .awp.md Capsule is the normative entry point and may reference every other required file or binding; a companion locator may point to it but is not a second authority.
read_first.question: What is the normative project entry point for AWP 0.8?
read_first.rationale: A single portable entry surface prevents duplicated discovery state and conflicting starting instructions.
read_first.supersession_rationale: The earlier 0.8 project decision made the companion discovery document coauthoritative; the project owner restored capsule-first discovery.

read_first.choice: Make Decision Durability a key AWP feature: accepted decisions retain explicit applicability, source, rationale, and supersession lineage; task-scoped entry computes a bounded decision closure and reports decision context independently from structural completeness.
read_first.question: How must AWP preserve governing choices across agents and sessions?
read_first.rationale: A structurally complete re-entry omitted a relevant accepted ADR and caused two agents to nearly re-propose a settled architecture.

read_first.statement: The AWP 0.8 draft uses a COOP-1/2/3 work-coordination ladder: COOP-1 reduces collisions through deterministic guarded work and recovery; COOP-2 adds semantic awareness and integration assurance; COOP-3 adds protected enforcement and scale. Portable collaboration needs no named contract, and consultation is optional.

read_first.mitigation: Complete an end-to-end COOP-1 work trial without consultation, then separately implement and test consultation-loop enforcement before claiming that optional subprotocol.
read_first.statement: The local prototype has guarded work, receipt-backed exit, canonical checkpoint projection, and fresh-entry integrity checks, but does not yet compose every COOP-1 work requirement in one binding or provide independent interoperability evidence. The optional consultation subprotocol has no binding-owned interaction storage, repeat-key deduplication, or loop-budget enforcement.

read_first.title: Compose and test a complete COOP-1 cooperation binding

Decide and implement the Capsule artifact-manifest split: 51 percent of the capsule is 106 artifact records and 44 are referenced by nothing; a format change now that 0.8.0 governs the capsule, so it needs a recorded format decision (accepted by actor:codex in interaction:409c879f2258ecd7e98bf36e)

Dedupe coordination.md section 3 against cooperation-contracts.md: 13 statements and 7.5 KB restate the COOP integration model that cooperation-contracts.md owns, and the boundary consultation traced term collisions (staleness, precondition, verification) to this duplication

required_artifacts.name: ADR 0004: Single-file capsule is the portable discovery unit
